abilities.name: Hatred
abilities.description: Basic Attacks grant a stack of Hatred, up to 10. Each Hatred stack increases Basic Attack damage by 8% and Movement Speed by 1%. Lasts 5 seconds.; trait

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Valla's Basic Attack damage. Movement Speed stacks additively with itself, but not with other Movement Speed effects.

abilities.name: Hungering Arrow
abilities.description: Fire an arrow that deals 140 damage to the first target hit, then seeks up to 2 additional enemies, prioritizing Heroes, dealing 80 damage. Can hit an enemy multiple times.

fields.notes: Bounces prioritize targets within the target groups that have gone the longest time without being hit by a bounce from the current cast of Hungering Arrow. Heroes are still prioritized over anything else. Enemies that are immune to skillshots can still be hit by the bounces, but not by the initial projectile. Bounce projectiles can be disjointed via Teleports, but only by Teleporting more than 3 units from the previous hit before it connects.

abilities.name: Multishot
abilities.description: Deal 159 damage to enemies within the target area.

fields.notes: 1) Area grows to its maximum radius over 0.375 seconds in increments of 1.15.

abilities.name: Vault
abilities.description: Dash to the target area. Valla's next Basic Attack within 2 seconds deals 6% increased damage per stack of Hatred.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and multiplicatively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Valla's Basic Attack damage. Vault is unhindered, which means Valla can move through all units with it. Affects the next Basic Attack that fires after finishing casting Vault, even if another Basic Attack was still in flight before casting Vault.

abilities.name: Strafe
abilities.description: Rapidly attack enemies within 10 range for 70 damage per hit, prioritizing Heroes over Minions. Valla is able to move and use Vault while strafing. Lasts for 4 seconds.; 60; 60; heroic

fields.notes: Strafe prioritizes the closest enemies within the target group. Does not affect unaggroed neutral Mercenaries. Strafe can hit the same target only once per 0.3125 seconds, making it possible to hit a single enemy only a maximum of 11 times. Valla retains current stacks of Hatred during Strafe and their duration is refreshed when Strafe ends. Valla cannot Mount, use Healing Fountains or channel objectives while Strafe is active.

abilities.name: Rain of Vengeance
abilities.description: Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds. Stores up to 2 charges.; 50; 50; heroic

fields.notes: 1) Area consists of six overlapping 2.8 x 2.8 sub-areas that impact one by one over 0.5 seconds. Enemies cannot be hit more than once.

talents.name: Puncturing Arrow
talents.description: Increase the number of Hungering Arrow bounces by 1. questonly Hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Hungering Arrow refunds 40 Mana and permanently increases the damage of its initial impact by 6.
_raw_fields: Increase the number of Hungering Arrow bounces by 1. questonly Hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Hungering Arrow refunds 40 Mana and permanently increases the damage of its initial impact by 6.

talents.name: Fire at Will
talents.description: Quest Hitting a Hero with Multishot grants 2 Hatred and permanently increases its damage by 2. After hitting 20 Heroes with Multishot, increase its damage by 40.

fields.notes: Continues to gain stacks after the quest is completed.

_raw_fields: Quest Hitting a Hero with Multishot grants 2 Hatred and permanently increases its damage by 2. After hitting 20 Heroes with Multishot, increase its damage by 40.

talents.name: Creed of the Hunter
talents.description: questonly Every 50 Basic Attacks against Heroes increases Hatred's damage bonus per stack by 1%, up to 6%. Gambitonly Gain 25% bonus Attack Speed. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

fields.notes: Attack Speed loss on death only affects the bonus gained from the Gambit (and cannot go below 0%). Attack Speed from Creed of the Hunter stacks additively with other effects that can affect Attack Speed.

_raw_fields: questonly Every 50 Basic Attacks against Heroes increases Hatred's damage bonus per stack by 1%, up to 6%. Gambitonly Gain 25% bonus Attack Speed. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

talents.name: Arsenal
talents.description: Increase the range of Multishot by 20%. Multishot also fires 3 grenades that deal 100 damage and refund 25 Mana after hitting enemy Heroes.

fields.notes: Increases the time Multishot takes to expand to its new maximum radius by 0.125 seconds. Grenades are launced at the very middle and both edges of the AoE. Grenades are unaffected by Fire at Will 's damage bonus. A Hero cannot be hit by any of the grenades more than once. Grenades take 0.5 seconds to reach their maximum distance.

_raw_fields: Increase the range of Multishot by 20%. Multishot also fires 3 grenades that deal 100 damage and refund 25 Mana after hitting enemy Heroes.

talents.name: Death Dealer
talents.description: Increase Vault's Basic Attack damage bonus from 6% to 15% per stack of Hatred. If this attack kills its victim within 1.5 seconds, the Mana cost and cooldown of Vault are refunded. Passive Reduce the cooldown of Vault by 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Any unit killing the target triggers the reset.

_raw_fields: Increase Vault's Basic Attack damage bonus from 6% to 15% per stack of Hatred. If this attack kills its victim within 1.5 seconds, the Mana cost and cooldown of Vault are refunded. Passive Reduce the cooldown of Vault by 5 seconds.

talents.name: Repeating Arrow
talents.description: Vault no longer has a Mana cost. Casting Vault resets the cooldown of Hungering Arrow.
_raw_fields: Vault no longer has a Mana cost. Casting Vault resets the cooldown of Hungering Arrow.

talents.description: Hungering Arrow deals 150% additional damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Hungering Arrow 's damage.

_raw_fields: Hungering Arrow deals 150% additional damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

talents.name: Siphoning Arrows
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Hungering Arrow heals Valla for 4% of her maximum Health, and Multishot heals for 2%.

fields.notes: Hungering Arrow triggers healing for the initial hit and each bounce (provided they hit a Hero) and Multishot for each enemy Hero hit.

talents.description: Basic Attacks heal for 10% of the damage dealt, increased by 2% per Hatred stack.

fields.notes: Lifesteal bonus stacks additively with itself and other lifesteal effects.

talents.name: Gloom
talents.description: Cooldown 5 Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds. Passive Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 Health per second.

fields.notes: Actually heals for 1.25 Health per second, but there is a tooltip error. Spell Armor from active component stacks additively with itself and the passive component. Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.description: While at max Hatred, Multishot's cooldown recharges 50% faster. Passive Reduce Multishot's Mana cost from 75 to 55.

fields.notes: While active, reduces the cooldown of Multishot by 0.125 seconds every 0.25 seconds.

talents.name: Manticore
talents.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

fields.notes: Bonus damage is dealt in a separate instance. Stacks toward bonus last for up to 5 minutes and persist after that Hero's death. The first stacks applied to any Hero start being replaced if the total stack count across all Hero units reaches 20 (possible against certain team compositions with high Heroic unit counts, including Hallucinations).

_raw_fields: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 4% of their maximum Health as damage.

talents.name: Death Siphon
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Strafe increases its duration by 0.125 seconds. Strafe also fires penetrating bolts in a line for 34 damage every 0.25 seconds.

fields.notes: Death Siphon 's piercing bolts can target the same enemy only once every 0.375 seconds. Death Siphon bolts do not prioritize Heroes or closer enemies. Targets are chosen at random from all valid targets in the area. Only regular bolts increase the duration.

_raw_fields: Hitting an enemy Hero with Strafe increases its duration by 0.125 seconds. Strafe also fires penetrating bolts in a line for 34 damage every 0.25 seconds.

fields.notes: Attack Speed from Storm of Vengeance stacks additively with itself and other Attack Speed effects.
